THE WHITE HOUSE
Office of the Press Secretary

For Immediate ReleaseJune 27, 1998
PRESS AVAILABILITY BY PRESIDENT CLINTON AND PRESIDENT JIANG
Beijing

12:05 P.M. (L)

PRESIDENT JIANG: The talks were positive and productive.

PRESIDENT CLINTON: Our relationship is important to both countries.

THE PRESS: Thank you.
